result.instructions: VRoid Studio MCP. Tool names and arguments are English. Call vroid_help('overview') before a complex task; vroid_help supports lang=en|fr|ja|zh-CN. VRoid Studio must be running with the bridge loaded. Only one model can be open at a time. Call vroid_status first. Save before vroid_main_menu, vroid_open or vroid_create. For visual work, use vroid_screenshot. For preset discovery, use vroid_preset_cache_search before applying presets. For sequences, use vroid_batch (up to 200 sequential operations, no automatic rollback). Do not assume that one preset replaces only one slot: whole outfits can replace several slots; verify with vroid_list_groups. Thumbnail generation strips all clothes, underwear and hair except the tested item. An English Agent Reference is exposed as MCP resources: vroid://agent/reference (full), plus vroid://agent/start, face, hairstyle, body, outfit, accessories, look, physical, presets, tools, workflows and troubleshooting. Read only the section needed; tools/list stays the authoritative schema list. MCP prompts: start (open a working session), character (build a character from a description), export_vrm (full/balanced/light VRM export), help. Reply in the user's language; never overwrite the user's .vroid file or discard changes without asking.

tools.name: vroid_help
tools.description: Show the built-in manual. Topics: overview, tools, lifecycle, export, framing, thumbnails, colors, outfit, sessions, errors, languages, batch. lang=en|fr|ja. Call this first when unsure.

lang.description: manual language: en (default), fr, ja, zh-CN

tools.name: vroid_batch
tools.description: Run several vroid_* operations sequentially in one MCP call and return a text summary plus optional images. Up to 200 operations, no nested batches, no automatic rollback. stop_on_error defaults to true. Images are capped (8 images / 16 MiB); excess images are reported by path only. Save before destructive sequences.

stop_on_error.description: stop at the first error (default true)

include_images.description: include returned images in the same response (default true, capped)

tools.name: vroid_status
tools.description: Report whether VRoid Studio responds, whether a model is open, its current file, whether it has unsaved changes (dirty) and whether the editor is ready.

tools.name: vroid_create
tools.description: Create a new model from the VRoid template (female or male), like the Create New Model dialog. VRoid must be at the model-select screen (no model open). Blocks until the model is ready. The new model has no file yet: use vroid_save with path to save it.

tools.name: vroid_open
tools.description: Open a .vroid file and wait until the model is ready. VRoid must be at the model-select screen (no model open): save and call vroid_main_menu first if needed. path must be absolute.

tools.name: vroid_save
tools.description: Save the open model. With path: Save As (creates the file). Without path: save in place, only if the model already has a .vroid file. A model created with vroid_create has no file yet: pass path.

path.description: absolute path of the .vroid file to write (optional)

tools.name: vroid_export_vrm
tools.description: Export the open model as a .vrm file with VRoid's own exporter, without clicks or file dialog (same options as the 'Export as VRM' screen). Options left out use VRoid's defaults: VRM 1.0, transparent meshes deleted, no reduction. Takes about 10-40 s. Reduction sliders are 0..100. material_mode: 0 Default, 1 = 2 materials, 2 = 8, 3 = 12. Texture size: with material_mode 0 use texture_mode 1 (Shrunk); with material reduction VRoid uses the atlas instead, so use atlas_resolution 1 (2048) to shrink textures. Any option VRoid refused is listed in 'warnings'. The model itself is not modified.

path.description: absolute path of the .vrm to write

title.description: model name in the VRM meta (default: file name)

model_version.description: model version in the VRM meta

leave.description: return to the editor after export (default true); false leaves the export screen open

tools.name: vroid_export_vrm_options
tools.description: Open VRoid's export screen and return its current export settings and the available material / texture / atlas choices. Close it again with vroid_export_vrm or by passing leave.

leave.description: close the export screen after reading (default true)

tools.name: vroid_main_menu
tools.description: Return to the model-select screen without quitting VRoid, so another model can be opened or created. Refuses when there are unsaved changes unless discard=true.

tools.name: vroid_exit
tools.description: Quit VRoid Studio gracefully. Refuses unsaved changes unless discard=true. The response is sent before the process exits; use it after a generation sequence.

tools.name: vroid_framing_get
tools.description: Read thumbnail framing profiles per category/body part (e.g. Clothing/Tops, Clothing/Shoes, Hair, Face, VRoid/ClothingSet), never per individual garment: garment facts stay in the cache. top/bottom are fractions from the top of the model (0 = top, 1 = feet), half is the half-width (null = full width), distance is the zoom-out factor, yaw is the orientation in degrees (0 = front, 90 = profile, 180 = back), fit=region|full-body. Without category: all known categories.

tools.name: vroid_framing_set
tools.description: Change the framing of a category/body part (e.g. Clothing/Tops, Clothing/Shoes, Hair, Face, VRoid/ClothingSet), never an individual garment: the override is local and does not modify committed defaults. top/bottom in 0..1, half null or 0.01..1, distance 1..10, yaw -180..180 (0 = front, 90 = profile, 180 = back), fit=region|full-body. vroid_framing_reset restores the defaults.

half.description: half-width as a fraction of height

distance.description: zoom-out factor (default 3.3; 4.2 for a whole outfit)

yaw.description: orientation in degrees: 0 front, 90 profile, 180 back

tools.name: vroid_framing_reset
tools.description: Clear framing overrides (all, or one category/body part) and return to the committed defaults in config/framing.json. Local overrides live in preset_cache/framing_overrides.json.

tools.name: vroid_list_groups
tools.description: List the editable groups of the open model (face, eyes, hair, body, outfits...). Each group has an id to pass to the other tools.

tools.name: vroid_get_params
tools.description: List the parameters of a group (blendshape sliders, bones, colors) with their current values.

tools.name: vroid_get_item_params
tools.description: List every adjustable parameter of the model's items, including the shape sliders VRoid shows under Customize > Parameters for clothing and accessories (skirt tighter/wider/shorter/longer, sleeve thickness, width, length, hood...), which vroid_get_params does not return. Each group has 'pars' (regular parameters) and 'sliders' (key, label, value). Clothing sliders range 0..100 (not 0..1); the last word of the label says what they do (Narrow = tighter, Spread = wider, Short, Long...). Set one with vroid_set_blendshape group=<group> key=<slider key> value=<0..100>; undoable. 'type' filters by group type, e.g. TransferableGroupType.N00.Level1.Bottoms.

type.description: optional group type filter, e.g. TransferableGroupType.N00.Level1.Bottoms

tools.name: vroid_sections
tools.description: List editable sections and their categories (Face, Hairstyle, Body, Outfit, Accessories, Look), with group counts. High-level companion to vroid_list_groups.

tools.name: vroid_categories
tools.description: List categories in a section (or all categories), with category key, label, section and group count. Use with vroid_enter / vroid_set_param.

section.description: section name (optional: Face, Hairstyle, Body, Outfit, Accessories, Look)

tools.name: vroid_enter
tools.description: Select a section/category by name and return its group and enriched parameters (labels + stable section/category/key paths). Equivalent in spirit to enter(), without changing VRoid's UI tab.

section.description: section, e.g. Face, Hairstyle, Body, Outfit

category.description: category or human label from vroid_categories

tools.name: vroid_set_param
tools.description: Set a parameter by section/category and key or short label; dispatches to bone, blendshape or color. Accepts numbers, #RRGGBB or r,g,b for colors. Unified counterpart of vroid_set_bone / vroid_set_blendshape / vroid_set_color.

section.description: section, e.g. Face, Hairstyle, Body, Outfit

category.description: category or human label from vroid_categories

param.description: parameter key, path or short label from vroid_enter

tools.name: vroid_set_blendshape
tools.description: Set a shape slider (blendshape) of a group. Undoable in VRoid (Ctrl+Z). Also sets clothing/accessory preset sliders: pass a 'template:...' key from vroid_get_item_params (values 0..100). Returns the value read back from VRoid.

key.description: parameter key (see vroid_get_params), or the 'template:...' key of a clothing slider (see vroid_get_item_params)

value.description: new value (0..1; 0..100 for a clothing slider)

tools.name: vroid_set_bone
tools.description: Set a bone transform parameter (body proportions, size...).

tools.name: vroid_set_color
tools.description: Set a color (components 0..1). Undoable in VRoid.

tools.name: vroid_colorize
tools.description: Composite color pass: apply one color to both the global/material colors and the texture layers of a group (clothing or hair). target=global|texture|both. Fine-grained vroid_set_color / vroid_recolor_layer remain available. Undoable; hair textures may not be exposed, in which case a warning is returned.

target.description: global colors, texture layers, or both (default)

tools.name: vroid_list_layers
tools.description: List the editable textures of a group (e.g. skirt = Bottoms): items (transferable), images and layers (node, name, opacity, visibility, blend mode). Clothes have no color sliders: their color is changed through their texture layers.

tools.name: vroid_recolor_layer
tools.description: Recolor a texture layer in place, preserving transparency; undoable. mode 'multiply': light fabric -> target color while keeping shadows and folds. mode 'colorize': keeps luminance, forces the hue (for already colored fabric).

tools.name: vroid_export_layer
tools.description: Export a texture layer as PNG (RGBA) to edit it with another tool.

tools.name: vroid_import_layer
tools.description: Import a PNG into a layer (same size as the export) or as a new layer. Undoable.

node.description: layer id to replace (ignored if as_new_layer)

as_new_layer.description: add as a new layer instead of replacing

tools.name: vroid_list_hair_materials
tools.description: List hair materials (hair color is not exposed by vroid_get_params): id, name, adjustable colors (key + value) and textures with their layers (transferable/image/node usable with vroid_recolor_layer).

tools.name: vroid_set_hair_color
tools.description: Set a color of a hair material (components 0..1). Undoable. 'base:<id>' keys are the overlay hair tint of a preset: change that key to recolor a preset hairstyle (material is optional in that case). For hair whose color is painted in the texture, recolor the layers instead (mode colorize).

tools.name: vroid_list_hair_groups
tools.description: List hair groups: 'procedural' (adjustable length and strand count) or 'brush' (drawn strands: count, average length, strandIds for the strand point/material tools).

tools.name: vroid_set_procedural_hair
tools.description: Set the length and/or strand count of a procedural hair group. Undoable.

tools.name: vroid_scale_brush_hair
tools.description: Lengthen (factor > 1) or shorten (factor < 1) all strands of a brush hair group from their root. Undoable (one step per point).

tools.name: vroid_clone_brush_hair
tools.description: Duplicate a group of brush strands and offset the copy (in meters, model space) to add strands.

tools.name: vroid_get_hair_strand_points
tools.description: List the control points of one hand-drawn (brush) hair strand. Each point has index, point (x,y,z), normal (nx,ny,nz) and uv (u,v). Brush groups from vroid_list_hair_groups return strandIds. Read-only.

tools.name: vroid_move_hair_strand_point
tools.description: Move one control point of a hand-drawn hair strand in local space (x,y,z). Optional nx,ny,nz and u,v update the normal and UV; omitted values are kept. Undoable.

tools.name: vroid_duplicate_hair_strand
tools.description: Duplicate one hand-drawn hair strand inside its group to add layering, optionally offsetting the copy in metres (dx,dy,dz). Undoable.

tools.name: vroid_set_hair_material
tools.description: Assign a shared hair material to a brush hair group or to one strand. Get material ids from vroid_list_hair_materials. Undoable; the material is read back in the result.

strand.description: strand id (optional; omit for the whole group)

tools.name: vroid_list_hair_bones
tools.description: List hair physics bone groups: transferable, group, name, bone count, spring root rate, stiffness, gravity and collider radius. Optional transferable filter.

tools.name: vroid_set_hair_bone
tools.description: Set parameters of a hair bone group (bone count 1..20, spring root rate, stiffness, gravity, collider radius 0..1). Omitted values are kept. Undoable.

tools.name: vroid_undo
tools.description: Undo the last change in VRoid Studio.

tools.name: vroid_redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone change.

tools.name: vroid_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a clean 3D preview of the avatar (no VRoid UI) and return the image. MSAA 4x and SSAA 2x by default; width/height override the output size; clean=false captures the whole window. Use it to inspect edits accurately.

width.description: output width in pixels (0 = camera viewport)

height.description: output height in pixels (0 = camera viewport)

clean.description: true = 3D preview only (default), false = full window

tools.name: vroid_list_presets
tools.description: List VRoid presets (hairstyles, faces, outfits, bodies...). filter searches the resource path (e.g. 'Hair', 'Tops', 'Bottoms', 'Onepiece', 'Shoes', 'Face'). Also returns the list of categories. Only free or owned presets are listed unless include_locked.

include_locked.description: include paid presets that are not owned

tools.name: vroid_apply_preset
tools.description: Apply a preset (replaces the item in the same category, like clicking its thumbnail). Undoable. Whole-set presets can replace several slots: verify with vroid_list_groups.

preserve_material.description: keep the current material (colors) if possible

tools.name: vroid_clothing_colors
tools.description: List the adjustable colors of a clothing item (same preset): group + key to pass to vroid_set_color.

tools.name: vroid_begin_clothing_edit
tools.description: Switch a preset clothing item to texture editing (like VRoid's Edit button): its layers become available to vroid_list_layers / vroid_recolor_layer. Undoable.

tools.name: vroid_measure
tools.description: Measure the current model height in cm (same as VRoid's size label) and its bounds.

tools.name: vroid_set_body_size
tools.description: Set the height (cm) directly through the gender silhouette slider (FigureHeight/FigureSlender, proportions preserved), and optionally weight (kg), converted to waist width via BMI (VRoid has no weight). gender: female, male or neutral. Undoable.

tools.name: vroid_preset_cache_search
tools.description: Search the shared preset and custom-item cache (no VRoid needed): labels, descriptions, tags and colors (manual and auto-generated), plus the thumbnail path. Each result has label/labelSource/generated and preview: {kind, mannequin, clothing, underwear, hair, keptSlot, orientation, yaw, capturedAt, pixels, source}. Situation thumbnails are captured on a nude mannequin and framed front-on. All query words must match (e.g. 'short pleated blue skirt').

annotated_only.description: only presets that already have a description

include_locked.description: include paid presets that are not owned

status.description: new / changed in the last scan

tools.name: vroid_preset_cache_annotate
tools.description: Add or correct the label, description, tags and colors of a preset in the shared cache, for other AIs. A manual label overrides the generated one. Short lowercase tags (type, color, length, style).

tools.name: vroid_preset_thumbnail
tools.description: Return the thumbnail of a preset or custom item (image) to judge it without applying it: situation capture if available, otherwise VRoid's native icon (fetched on demand). Thumbnail metadata (mannequin, clothing, underwear, framing) is in the vroid_preset_cache_search result under preview.

tools.name: vroid_preset_cache_sync
tools.description: Scan what VRoid currently exposes: built-in presets AND custom items (with the name given in VRoid). Reports new, changed (renamed custom item or new revision) and removed items without erasing annotations; generates structural labels for new entries. Runs automatically on each VRoid start. icons=true also fetches native preset icons (fast, nothing is applied).

icon_limit.description: maximum number of icons to fetch

tools.name: vroid_preset_cache_build
tools.description: Create situation thumbnails for a category (presets, or Custom/<slot> for custom items). Removes ALL clothes, accessories, underwear (including default underwear, which shows through swimwear) and hair except BaseHair/the tested item; frames the character front-on and centered on its bounds; applies each item, checks that nothing else remains, captures, crops, then restores the original outfit. Writes thumbnailMeta (nude mannequin, clothing=tested-item-only, underwear=removed, strippedSlots, camera with fit, pixels, sha1) into catalog.json. Also generates a label and visual metadata (colors, brightness, plain/patterned) from the thumbnail; manual labels are never overwritten. Whole outfits pull the camera back so shoes stay visible; orientation (profile yaw: back for back hair, three-quarter for shoes/arm accessories) is applied. Save the model first: restoration is not guaranteed to be identical. About 3 s per preset; native icons (sync icons=true) are faster.

limit.description: maximum number of presets to process

tools.name: vroid_camera
tools.description: Aim the VRoid 3D view at the model from another angle before a capture. action: get (state + preset rotations), angles (x,y in degrees), rotate (dx,dy), zoom (d), pan (x,y), reset (initial view), mode (VRoid preset rotation), projection (toggle perspective/orthographic), custom (px,py,pz,cx,cy,cz).

tools.name: vroid_apply_custom
tools.description: Apply one of the user's custom items, like clicking it in VRoid's Custom tab: replaces the item in the same category. key = cache key (vroid_preset_cache_search kind=custom) or file = path to the .vroidcustomitem file. Undoable.

tools.name: vroid_remove_item
tools.description: Remove an item from the model (clothing, accessory, shoes...). group = group id, or a short type to remove all groups of that type (Tops, Bottoms, Onepiece, Socks, Shoes, InnerTop, ArmAccessory, NeckAccessory...). Useful to start from a model without clothes before creating thumbnails.

tools.name: vroid_face_preview
tools.description: Expression preview for a capture (open mouth to show teeth, smile, wink...): set the weight (0..100) of face blendshapes whose name ends with name (e.g. MTH_A, MTH_O, ALL_Joy, EYE_Close). Without name: list names (optional filter). Display only, nothing is saved; empty name with weight 0 resets everything.

tools.name: vroid_begin_hair_edit
tools.description: Switch a hair material to texture editing (VRoid's Edit button): its texture becomes available to the layer tools. Useful for a preset hairstyle whose texture is not editable.
